Description: Verify system accepts in-memory transport configuration
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: System shall support in-memory transport for standalone deployment

Step Description: Verify startup logs indicate in-memory transport active
Expected Result: Log message: "Transport mode: in-memory" or equivalent

Description: Verify system accepts Kafka transport configuration
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: System shall support Kafka transport for distributed deployment

Step Description: Verify startup logs indicate Kafka transport active
Expected Result: Log message: "Transport mode: kafka" or equivalent

Description: Verify same business logic works on both transports
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Transport layer shall be interchangeable without code changes
Step Description: Execute dispatch center routing test with in-memory transport
Execute same test with Kafka transport
Verify no transport-specific code in domain modules

Description: Verify Receiver module activates when enabled
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Each module (Receiver/Handler/Dispatcher) shall be independently configurable

Step Description: Send test event to Receiver input

Description: Verify Handler module activates when enabled
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Handler shall process events only when enabled

Description: Verify Dispatcher module activates when enabled
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Dispatcher shall route events only when enabled

Expected Result: Event published to dispatch center topic

Description: Verify system operates with modules disabled
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Disabling a module shall not crash the system

Step Description: Verify events stop at Receiver (no Handler processing)

Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: System shall support IPL dispatch center

Description: Verify WDX dispatch center configurable and operational
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: System shall support WDX dispatch center

Description: Verify UCRI dispatch center configurable and operational
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: System shall support UCRI dispatch center

Description: Verify POLICE dispatch center configurable and operational

Description: Verify correlationId present and preserved in all messages
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: All messages shall contain correlationId for traceability

Description: Verify custom headers preserved through pipeline

Description: Verify message envelope is immutable after creation
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Envelope shall be immutable to ensure data integrity
Step Description: Create MessageEnvelope with payload and metadata

Expected Result: Modification rejected or new envelope created
Modification rejected or new envelope created

Description: Verify events with same partition key maintain order
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Events shall be ordered by partition key
Step Description: Send 5 events with same operationId (partition key) in order A-B-C-D-E
Verify destination receives events in order A-B-C-D-E

Description: Verify CreateRequest flows from IPL to external dispatch centers
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: IPL shall send operations to WDX/UCRI/POLICE
Pre-conditions: IPL enabled; at least one external center enabled

Step Description: Set targetMandant to external dispatch center
Verify event delivered to target dispatch center

Description: Verify AcceptOperation response flows back to requester
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Dispatch centers shall respond with Accept/Reject
Pre-conditions: Request submitted and received by target

Step Description: Verify response routed back to original requester
Verify correlationId links request and response

Description: Verify RejectOperation response flows back with reason
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Rejections shall include reason for rejection
Pre-conditions: Request submitted and received by target
Step Description: Target dispatch center decides to reject
Target triggers RejectOperation with reason field
Verify response routed back to original requester

Description: Verify retry mechanism configurable
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: System shall retry failed publishes with configurable attempts and delay

Description: Verify undeliverable events sent to DLQ
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Events failing all retries shall be sent to Dead Letter Queue
Step Description: Configure DLQ topic for dispatch center
Send event to unavailable dispatch center
Allow all retry attempts to fail
Verify event published to DLQ topic
Verify original payload preserved in DLQ message

Description: Verify events acknowledged within 10 seconds
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Events shall be acknowledged within 10 seconds

Description: Verify port interfaces free of infrastructure imports
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Ports shall define contracts without transport dependencies

Step Description: Run ArchUnit or equivalent guardrail test

Description: Verify adapters contain only delegation logic
Acceptance Criteria Reference: AC: Adapters shall delegate to infrastructure implementations

Step Description: Verify no Kafka-specific logic in adapter class
Verify no Vert.x-specific logic in adapter class

Verify error message indicates architecture violation
